2026-10-22.meaning: To set something back to the state it started in — for example, restarting a device or a game so it begins again from its original settings.

2026-10-23.meaning: It is the bright, fluttering ornament a singer or player makes by flickering swiftly back and forth between two neighboring notes, too quick for the ear to separate.

2026-10-24.meaning: It is used for something pierced all the way through by lots of little round openings, like a slice of Swiss cheese or a moth-nibbled sweater left in a drawer.
